issues.reason: The whenever rule mints the response as a Skolem event PER OCCURRENCE (its example keys (sk_bark $x) on the ring event) and the scope rule makes a dependent existential a function of every universal scoping over it, so (sk_gain $x) keyed on the moth alone collapses repeated flee-and-reach occurrences by one moth into a single gain event carrying several During anchors.

gaps_confirmed: a definite plural group ('the lanterns') as subject of a distributive predicate inside a rule consequent: the group-event-plus-per-member-rule pairing is stated for top-level clauses only, with no word on nesting or hoisting that distribution inside an Implication
new_gaps: a bare-plural object inside a rule consequent ('gain silken threads'): the bare-plural-object rule splits episodic (group witness) from kind-level (bare kind filler) only for top-level clauses and says nothing about whether a per-occurrence consequent takes a Skolem-function group or the bare kind
a coordinated trigger clause ('flees and reaches') under whenever: nothing says which trigger event the consequent's During anchors on, or whether the Skolem event takes both occurrence variables
defect_summary: Issue 0: mint the gain per occurrence — (sk_gain $e2) (or of every premise universal, (sk_gain $x $e1 $e2)) with (During (sk_gain …) $e2), exactly as the whenever example keys (sk_bark $x) on the ring event; every other atom stands as emitted.
notes: The Name-only 'the Hollows', LocatedIn on the definite lantern group, the nightmoth and silken_thread decompositions, and the whenever routing of bare 'when' with an indefinite trigger participant all follow the instruction set.
